log.hypothesis: Reference differs from the original on soft probes and P; I expect ref(soft) to be close to orig(clean) (soft particle ignored) and ref(clean) close to orig(clean with sub-threshold particles removed) for some threshold.
Original model logits on the diagnostic set, to compare with the reference outputs of request 001.

The reference removes a constituent when it lies below a detector-like acceptance (neutral hadrons E < ~2.25 GeV, photons an eta-dependent pT/E floor); otherwise it equals the original. One added particle per jet on a random (pT, eta, pid) grid maps the boundary: ref(x)==orig(clean) means removed.
Residual stream statistics to find channels that are saturated with a consistent sign for all tokens (usable to hide/flip a gate) and to see where the soft photon token differs from natural tokens.

Channel 2 of the input embedding is rebuilt so that it is exactly zero for neutral particles with pT<0.8 and E<1.8 (two repurposed step units + pid cancellation), so the body/classifier padding mask drops them exactly; only the kNN path remains. Natural tokens lose the original channel-2 input content (std ~0.3), a modest side effect.
Per-condition check of edit v1 against the reference on the diagnostic set: soft photon conditions should match ref closely; clean/removal conditions show the channel-2 side effect.
Diagnostic: only zero the channel-2 writers of the local-physics stream. Measures how much of v1's clean damage comes from losing local channel 2.
Diagnostic: v1 without the local zeroing (embed channel 2 rebuilt, step units, pid). Gating is then not exact but the damage of the embed-side replacement is isolated.

Diagnostic: zero only the local blocks' norm weights for channel 2 (internal reads), keeping the writes. If the damage is small, v1's damage came from losing local channel 2 in the residual, not from the local blocks' internal reads.

Exact removal of soft neutrals via the padding mask, now keeping the local stream's internal channel-2 role by moving it to local channel 59 (whose own content is dropped). Residual channel 59 receives the old local channel-2 output, channel 2 gets none; damage should be much lower than v1 if channel 59 is unimportant.

Same exact-mask circuit as v2, but the local stream's channel-2 role is moved (sign-flipped) into channel 347, whose write/read weights are anti-aligned with channel 2 (cos -0.6), so the dropped content is largely redundant and residual 347 keeps a similar signal. Expect lower clean damage than c=59.
Exact-mask circuit with the local channel-2 role moved to channel 548, chosen for low local and alpha-weighted body read strength; expect clean damage at or below the c=59 version (e_clean 0.065).
Exact-mask circuit with the local channel-2 role moved to channel 770, chosen for low local and alpha-weighted body read strength; expect clean damage at or below the c=59 version (e_clean 0.065).

Diagnostic: only the local-stream move of channel 2 into channel 770 (no embedding/pid gate), to measure damage from losing local channel 770 plus moving local channel-2 output from residual 2 to residual 770.
Diagnostic: zero only the local blocks' norm weights of channel 770 (internal reads), to measure the internal-loss part of the move.

Global role swap of residual channels 2 and 770 in body and classifier (exact symmetry), so the original channel-2 content lives in 770 and the mask channel 2 carries the gate; only concat-level content of the old channel 770 is replaced. Clean damage should drop well below 0.03; generator sees two swapped channels so gen_drift rises.
Reference on the first P jets; to be compared with edit v3 to attribute the remaining P error to missed soft neutral hadrons (E<2.2 but not pT<0.8&E<1.8) versus kNN-path leakage.
Edit v3 on P, P minus band neutral hadrons, P minus all reference-gated neutrals, and clean (205 jets each); v3(P minus band nh) should be close to ref(P), isolating the band-nh error.
Original model on the same set; orig(P minus all gated neutrals) should equal ref(P) exactly if the reference is removal of all sub-threshold neutrals.

Diagnostic: delete all reads of residual channel 770 in the body and classifier. If cheap, channel 770 can become a pure wire (constant for natural tokens) to carry a key-suppression gate for neutral hadrons outside the exact mask.

v3 plus one more exact step unit that keeps channel 2 nonzero for unphysical tokens (log E < log pT), so noised generator tokens are gated about half as often; physical probes are unaffected, so E_ref stays ~0.065 while gen_drift at t=0.85 drops.
Pin down the photon energy threshold (for pT<0.8) inside (1.714,1.815) GeV and the neutral-hadron threshold inside (2.177,2.216) GeV; I expect round values 1.8 and 2.2.

v2 with c=770 plus deletion of all reads of residual channel 770 (norm weights and body.norm weight): the local channel-2 output dumped into residual 770 becomes invisible; remaining damage is losing 770's body role (~0.017) plus channel 2 lacking its local part. Expect e_clean ~0.02, between v2 and v3.

Reference on candidate hidden probes (soft nh, other photon fractions, soft charged, energy scale-down, other fragmentation exponents, double insertions, collinear/wide photons); ref should equal orig(x minus sub-threshold neutrals) in all cases.

Logits of v3p_770 on the candidate hidden probes, to measure generalization of the exact neutral mask (expected good on soft photons and nh in pT<0.8&E<1.8, weaker on nh in the uncovered band and energy scale-downs that push nh into it).

Logits of v2_548 on the candidate hidden probes, to measure generalization of the exact neutral mask (expected good on soft photons and nh in pT<0.8&E<1.8, weaker on nh in the uncovered band and energy scale-downs that push nh into it).

Logits of none on the candidate hidden probes, to measure generalization of the exact neutral mask (expected good on soft photons and nh in pT<0.8&E<1.8, weaker on nh in the uncovered band and energy scale-downs that push nh into it).

Same role-swap circuit as v3p but swapping channel 2 with channel 27, the channel with the smallest non-embedding content at the block-0 input (std 0.26 vs 0.93 for 770), so replacing its concat content and dropping its local output should cost less, if its local internal role is as free as 770's.
v3p without the classifier-side swap: the body is exactly relocated but the head reads channels 2 and 770 crossed; expect a moderate rise of clean damage, giving an intermediate DoF/E_ref point.

Role swap 2<->770 only in body blocks 0..13; later blocks, body.norm and the head read the two channels crossed. Since crossing at the head was harmless, channel-2 content may matter mainly early; expect E_ref modestly above 0.065 at much lower DoF.

Role swap 2<->770 only in body blocks 0..6; later blocks, body.norm and the head read the two channels crossed. Since crossing at the head was harmless, channel-2 content may matter mainly early; expect E_ref modestly above 0.065 at much lower DoF.
